title: WorkCoPilot - Security & Business Audit: Findings and Remediation
subtitle: Assessment of the external (ChatGPT black-box) audit against the actual implementation
source: External AI audit (ChatGPT), black-box crawl of the public site. Most items are potential risks to verify, not confirmed vulnerabilities.

legend.Partial: A control exists; an edge or public-facing gap remains
legend.Gap: A valid open item to fix
legend.verdict_note: 0 confirmed exploitable vulnerabilities. The read-only architecture (never clicks, types or runs) plus on-device redaction mitigate the AI/screen risk class.

findings.title: Security-page discoverability
findings.rationale: A /security page and a downloadable Security & Privacy paper exist; the crawler saw little because the SPA is client-rendered and because we deliberately removed build-recipe detail. The posture is published.
findings.remediation: Server-side render / prerender the security page; keep posture public, not the mechanism.

findings.title: Sensitive screen exposure
findings.rationale: On-device redaction (text + screen), selective sharing, allow/block scrub rules, pause/clear, content-protection are implemented.
findings.remediation: None; verify in the enterprise control test pass.

findings.title: Use on restricted corporate devices
findings.rationale: Company authorization attestation + disclaimer require the organization to affirm authorization.
findings.remediation: Reinforce the authorization message in public copy (done in AUP).

findings.title: Potentially unsafe AI instructions
findings.rationale: DestructiveGate classifies destructive commands and requires confirmation; security-first WORK_MODE writes and validates commands; disclaimer applies.
findings.remediation: Add explicit per-OS validation (see 2.9).

findings.title: Unclear product scope
findings.rationale: Marketing said 'any task, any field'. The new professions section (56 fields) sharpens scope; the disclaimer states limits.
findings.remediation: Name supported platforms, permissions and modes on the site.

findings.title: Pricing transparency
findings.rationale: A plan-comparison matrix exists on the homepage; the crawler could not read it (SPA render).
findings.remediation: Add machine-readable structured data + SSR for the pricing section.

findings.title: Parent-company credibility
findings.rationale: COE Security LLC ownership was not stated.
findings.remediation: Added 'WorkCoPilot, by AdmireVeda, a product of COE Security LLC' to the footer and trust pages; being extended to About/checkout.

findings.title: Search discoverability
findings.rationale: Client-rendered SPA returns similar minimal content per route to crawlers.
findings.remediation: Server-side render or prerender public pages; per-route meta/canonical/structured data; validate in Search Console.

findings.title: Prompt injection through screen content
findings.rationale: Screen content is treated as data and the product is read-only, which removes the impact of an injected instruction (nothing is executed). Explicit indirect-injection testing is not yet formalized.
findings.remediation: Separate system instructions from extracted content; add an indirect-prompt-injection test suite.

findings.title: AI gaining excessive permissions
findings.rationale: Read-only by architecture: WorkCoPilot recommends, it never clicks, types or runs.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Secrets included in AI requests
findings.rationale: On-device secret detection + masking before anything leaves the device.
findings.remediation: None; covered by the control test pass.

findings.title: Cross-customer data leakage
findings.rationale: Data is user- and company-scoped by design; formal cross-tenant (BOLA/IDOR) testing is not yet documented.
findings.remediation: Run tenant-scoped authorization tests across all APIs; publish the result.

findings.title: Untrusted command execution
findings.rationale: Model output is never executed; commands are shown to the user and security-checked.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Incorrect error detection
findings.rationale: Security-first validation + 'not professional advice' disclaimer exist; explicit confidence thresholds are partial.
findings.remediation: Add confidence thresholds + an escalation path when confidence is low.

findings.title: Third-party AI provider exposure
findings.rationale: The security paper documents that AI is processed by a major provider under that provider's terms; a formal subprocessor list is not yet published.
findings.remediation: Maintain a subprocessor list (available under NDA / in the DPA), without naming the model publicly.

findings.title: Unbounded AI usage
findings.rationale: Daily task cap, per-tier minute pools, and the failover ladder bound usage.
findings.remediation: None; add anomaly alerts as a maturity item.

findings.title: Instruction reliability across operating systems
findings.rationale: The engine reads on-screen OS context; explicit platform validation is partial.
findings.remediation: Detect the environment, ask for missing context, validate commands against the platform.

findings.title: Unsafe output rendering
findings.rationale: The UI renders guidance through React (which escapes by default) and a limited markdown renderer, not raw HTML; a formal CSP is not yet set.
findings.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy; confirm no raw-HTML injection path.

findings.title: Loss of user control during screen sharing
findings.rationale: Persistent capture indicator, pause/clear, and visible controls exist; the installed app is hidden from screen shares by default.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Screenshot & conversation retention
findings.rationale: Two-tier configurable retention (company + individual, superadmin-set) with deletion.
findings.remediation: Publish a public data-lifecycle table.

findings.title: Authentication controls
findings.rationale: Invite-only SSO (OIDC/PKCE) and server sessions are implemented; MFA for password accounts + API rate-limiting are deferred to the production phase.
findings.remediation: Add MFA + rate limiting + session-revocation docs (production phase).

findings.title: Authorization & API exposure
findings.rationale: Role guards (auth, company-admin, executive, superadmin) and company-scoping are in place; a formal authorization test pass is pending.
findings.remediation: Run BOLA/IDOR + privilege-escalation tests across all APIs.

findings.title: Encryption & key management
findings.rationale: AES-256-GCM at rest, TLS in transit, keyfile at 0600.
findings.remediation: Move to KMS-backed key rotation as a maturity item.

findings.title: Enterprise administration
findings.rationale: RBAC, SSO provisioning, session controls, and an audit log are implemented.
findings.remediation: Add SCIM as a maturity item.

findings.title: Task history containing sensitive info
findings.rationale: On-device redaction before persistence; audit metadata is separated from screen content.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Incident-response commitments
findings.rationale: No public security contact / disclosure policy previously.
findings.remediation: Published a 'Report a security issue' disclosure policy + security contact (support@coesecurity.com) on the Security page.

findings.title: Independent penetration-testing assurance
findings.rationale: No published WorkCoPilot-specific assessment.
findings.remediation: Commission + publish a sanitized third-party assessment (production phase).

findings.title: Business continuity
findings.rationale: AI-provider failover ladder + off-box DB backup discipline exist; formal SLA/RTO/RPO are not published.
findings.remediation: Define and publish SLA/RTO/RPO + tested restore.

findings.title: Compliance evidence gap
findings.rationale: Our standing rule: never claim certification; only 'compliance-ready + controls and evidence.'
findings.remediation: None; keep the honesty framing.

findings.title: Privacy policy / data rights
findings.rationale: A Privacy page exists; it is being updated to name COE Security LLC as controller and spell out data-subject rights.
findings.remediation: Name the legal entity + data rights (in progress); SSR for crawlability.

findings.title: Sensitive regulated information
findings.rationale: The 'not professional advice' disclaimer + on-device redaction exist; a supported/prohibited data-category policy is being added.
findings.remediation: Publish a data-category policy (in progress).

findings.title: Broad legal/accounting claims
findings.rationale: 'Practical guidance, not professional advice' disclaimer is applied in-product and on the site.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Contractual responsibility (ToS/AUP/DPA)
findings.rationale: No published Terms/AUP/DPA/refund previously.
findings.remediation: Published Terms of Service, Acceptable Use Policy, DPA summary, and Refund & Cancellation pages (templates, pending counsel sign-off).

findings.title: Subscription disputes
findings.rationale: Stripe billing + self-service cancellation portal exist; material terms are being surfaced pre-payment via the Refund page.
findings.remediation: Show subscription terms before payment (in progress).

findings.title: Unsupported benefit claims
findings.rationale: The result-correctness benchmark harness is built (held-out set); published numbers await a key-run. The executive dashboard labels savings as hypothetical.
findings.remediation: Run the benchmark + controlled pilots; publish only measured results.

findings.title: Intellectual-property exposure
findings.rationale: On-device redaction + configurable retention protect user IP; AUP + DPA add handling rules.
findings.remediation: None.

findings.title: Brand confusion between three names
findings.rationale: COE Security LLC / AdmireVeda / WorkCoPilot hierarchy was unclear.
findings.remediation: One consistent hierarchy across footer, trust pages and legal docs: COE Security LLC -> AdmireVeda -> WorkCoPilot.

findings.title: Sign-in destination ambiguity
findings.rationale: A distinct sign-in page exists; the crawler saw the overview because of SPA rendering.
findings.remediation: SSR + keep sign-in/sign-up/demo/pricing CTAs distinct.

findings.title: Lack of visible product proof
findings.rationale: A live demo + demo scenarios exist; real product screenshots are limited.
findings.remediation: Add product screenshots + a short workflow demo.

findings.title: Feature differentiation
findings.rationale: A compare-plans matrix exists; separate individual/team/enterprise journeys are partial.
findings.remediation: Add explicit buying journeys per segment.

findings.title: Unproven time-saving claims
findings.rationale: Time-saving claims are not yet backed by measured data.
findings.remediation: Run controlled pilots; publish measured completion time, outcomes, retention.

findings.title: Limited organic-search visibility
findings.rationale: SPA client-rendering exposes minimal crawlable content.
findings.remediation: SSR / static generation + sitemap + structured data (same fix as 1.8).

findings.title: Accessibility uncertainty
findings.rationale: No WCAG audit performed.
findings.remediation: WCAG 2.2 AA audit + fixes (incl. screen-share controls, keyboard, contrast).

findings.title: Onboarding guidance
findings.rationale: Help/FAQ + guided first-use exist.
findings.remediation: Add a guided first-use walkthrough + sample tasks + permission explanations.

findings.title: Support commitments
findings.rationale: No published support options previously.
findings.remediation: Published a Support contact (support@admireveda.com) in the footer; response targets to follow on a support page.

deferred_to_production.item: MFA for password accounts + API rate limiting (3.2)
deferred_to_production.reason: Owner decision: addressed at the production phase.
Owner decision: commissioned at the production phase.

remediation_plan.items: COE ownership + brand hierarchy (1.7, 4.8), security contact + disclosure (3.7), support contact (5.8).
Terms / AUP / DPA / refund pages (4.4), privacy legal entity + data rights + data-category policy (4.1, 4.2), data-lifecycle table (3.1).
remediation_plan.status: In progress this session (templates, pending counsel)

remediation_plan.items: SSR / prerender + structured data (1.8, 5.5, 5.1, 1.6) - resolves most 'crawler saw nothing' findings at once.
Authorization (BOLA) + indirect-prompt-injection test passes (3.3, 2.4, 2.1), CSP (2.10), per-OS validation (2.9), accessibility audit (5.6), benchmark/pilot numbers (5.4, 4.6).
MFA + rate limiting (3.2), independent pentest/attestation (3.8), SLA/RTO/RPO (3.9), SCIM + KMS rotation (3.5, 3.4).
